a_daily_overdue.rationale: Minimum tested deadline with zero eligible cohort crossings and at least one hour beyond p99.

bx_checkin_interval.rationale: The development median was 86,340 seconds. Use a nominal day to separate a single missed check-in from prolonged silence.

bx_daily_overdue.rationale: Minimum tested deadline with zero eligible cohort crossings and at least one hour beyond p99.

camera_recording_overdue.rationale: First tested value covering a median recording interval plus the p95 interval.

normal_receipt_lag.rationale: Smallest tested bound covering 99% of the routine cohort with lag at most 60 seconds. Larger lag remains recorded.

tracker_driving_overdue.provenance: Development driving cadence and outage sweep
tracker_driving_overdue.rationale: The observed within-drive maximum is 123 seconds. The grid ties retain the kit's three-position allowance. Use the same deadline for status and cohort analysis.

clock_ahead_tolerance.comparator: observation - receipt > value means clock quality uncertain
clock_ahead_tolerance.provenance: P00 clock policy and supplied first-receipt distribution
clock_ahead_tolerance.rationale: Keep the receipt for contact and withhold future-dated state.

json_integer_max_digits.provenance: P13 malformed-batch regression and CPython's minimum integer conversion limit
json_integer_max_digits.rationale: Keep oversize numbers local to one packet even if decimal conversion uses the strictest supported interpreter limit.

query_timestamp_requires_offset.provenance: Contract UTC and P00 clock policy

a_checkin_interval.rationale: A tags normally check in daily.

camera_sleep_delay.rationale: Expected sleep after asset ignition off.

ingest_response_limit.rationale: Full-size request deadline. Release verification targets strictly under ten seconds.

shift_start_local.rationale: Join operational deadlines in the asset's depot zone.

tracker_parked_overdue.rationale: Four hours 30 minutes with no valid report.

a_battery_recovery.rationale: A hysteresis margin above the low threshold. The observed replacements do not identify a unique boundary.

a_low_battery.provenance: Latest eligible telemetry at development battery case opening
a_low_battery.rationale: Smallest inclusive tested cutoff covering the available selected case readings. Validation has no labelled battery cases.

bx_battery_recovery.comparator: reading >= value and low flag clear
bx_battery_recovery.rationale: Conservative clear with hysteresis. No labelled recovery identifies an exact cutoff.

bx_percentage_only_low_enabled.provenance: BX portal and stream flag comparison
bx_percentage_only_low_enabled.rationale: The supplied readouts support the flag. Percentage-only decisions have no independent outcome labels.

camera_failed_reboots_before_visit.rationale: Two failures in one episode justify a physical check. Wear and case selection limit the evidence.

camera_reboot_response_grace.provenance: Awake reboot response sweep and camera cadence
camera_reboot_response_grace.rationale: Allow two ordinary recording opportunities to avoid premature escalation. The shorter tested window caught the same observed responses in a small selected sample.

camera_wake_grace.rationale: First tested grace at or above first-recording p95 plus receipt margin. Runtime should retest its boundary.

cold_healthy_battery_minimum.rationale: Require positive battery margin before cold can explain a missed report.

cold_silence_limit.rationale: Allow roughly one extra daily opportunity. Surface uncertainty when the grace expires.

cold_temperature.provenance: Development and held-out cold opportunity sweep
cold_temperature.rationale: Apply only to a healthy recent A battery context. This is bounded suppression of an unconfirmed symptom.

incident_close_below_remaining_devices.provenance: Contract incident cardinality and P00 episode policy
incident_close_below_remaining_devices.rationale: A group requires several devices. Reevaluate remaining serials individually.

outage_maximum_onset_spread_seconds.provenance: Development outage anchor and background snapshot grid
outage_maximum_onset_spread_seconds.rationale: Requires carrier-specific contrast and distinct due reporters. One labelled incident per split limits inference.

outage_minimum_affected_devices.provenance: Development outage anchor and background snapshot grid
outage_minimum_affected_devices.rationale: Requires carrier-specific contrast and distinct due reporters. One labelled incident per split limits inference.

outage_minimum_affected_share.provenance: Development outage anchor and background snapshot grid
outage_minimum_affected_share.rationale: Requires carrier-specific contrast and distinct due reporters. One labelled incident per split limits inference.

outage_minimum_healthy_comparison_device.provenance: Development outage anchor and background snapshot grid
outage_minimum_healthy_comparison_device.rationale: Requires carrier-specific contrast and distinct due reporters. One labelled incident per split limits inference.

outage_minimum_healthy_comparison_share.provenance: Development outage anchor and background snapshot grid
outage_minimum_healthy_comparison_share.rationale: Requires carrier-specific contrast and distinct due reporters. One labelled incident per split limits inference.

outage_probe_interval.comparator: opening probes on UTC multiples of value
outage_probe_interval.rationale: Use the calibrated sampling grid to reconstruct openings with a stable identity. Member recovery uses the exact receipt cutoff.

seasonal_downtime_suppression_enabled.comparator: requires approved scope and effective dates
seasonal_downtime_suppression_enabled.rationale: Observed seasonal silence supports an investigation without approval for suppression.

uncertain_fast_reporting_windows.comparator: elapsed > value times the family allowance
uncertain_fast_reporting_windows.rationale: Require prolonged fast-report silence and near-term scheduled use before opening an uncertain support follow-up.

urgent_operational_horizon.provenance: P00 working assumption, awaiting Larchmont policy
urgent_operational_horizon.rationale: Budget preparation time before scheduled use. Allow a pending remote check to finish when its response deadline precedes the work deadline.

coverage_monitor_limit.provenance: P01 observed maximum T delivery lag of 5,396 seconds, rounded to 90 minutes
coverage_monitor_limit.rationale: Provisional ceiling for coverage attribution on a still-overdue position.

weak_signal_max.provenance: Vendor heartbeat scale and P05 conservative engineering policy
weak_signal_max.rationale: Treat the lowest categories as corroboration with eligible device-specific buffering evidence.
weak_signal_max.unit: modem signal level on the supplied 0–5 scale

a_legacy_timestamp_scale.rationale: Decode numeric device times as epoch seconds.

bx_battery_low_mask.provenance: Vendor portal anchors and frame combinations
bx_battery_low_mask.rationale: Low battery flag includes the 14% portal example.

bx_coordinate_scale.rationale: Decode the two signed coordinate integers.

bx_gps_fix_mask.provenance: Vendor portal anchors and frame combinations
bx_gps_fix_mask.rationale: A no-fix frame retains contact without a new position.

bx_moving_mask.provenance: Vendor portal anchors and frame combinations

packet_epoch_end_seconds_exclusive.rationale: Reject out-of-range clocks and numeric milliseconds while retaining a portable instant range.

packet_epoch_start_seconds.rationale: Reject implausibly old clocks and accidental epoch-unit misreads.
